A caller that already set\\n * PAPERCUSP_TEST_PG_ADMIN_URL keeps its own server.\\n */\\nasync function startAcceptancePg(work: string): Promise<{ env: Record<string, string>; stop(): Promise<void> }> {\\n  if (process.env.PAPERCUSP_TEST_PG_ADMIN_URL) return { env: {}, stop: async () => {} };\\n  const pg = await startDedicatedNativePg({\\n    baseDir: work,\\n    settings: {\\n      max_connections: '500',\\n      fsync: 'off',\\n      synchronous_commit: 'off',\\n      full_page_writes: 'off',\\n      // Keep PostgreSQL logs in the collector so they do not interleave with\\n      // the acceptance leg's live stdout/stderr log.\\n      logging_collector: 'on',\\n    },\\n  });\\n  return { env: { PAPERCUSP_TEST_PG_ADMIN_URL: pg.getConnectionUri() }, stop: () => pg.stop() };\\n}\\n\\nexport const RELEASE_SUITES = [\\n  'packages/operator-core/lib/pui-e2e/agent-chat-pty.integration.test.ts',\\n  'packages/operator-core/lib/pui-e2e/context-pane-cockpit-pty.integration.test.ts',\\n];\\n/** The code that decides what counts; it must be the candidate's own copy. */\\nconst ACCEPTANCE_SOURCES = [\\n  ...RELEASE_SUITES,\\n  'packages/operator-core/lib/pui-e2e/release-acceptance.ts',\\n  'packages/operator-core/lib/pui-e2e/release-acceptance-reporter.ts',\\n  'packages/operator-core/lib/pui-e2e/release-acceptance-run.ts',\\n];\\nconst REPORTER = path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'packages/operator-core/lib/pui-e2e/release-acceptance-reporter.ts');\\nconst VITEST = path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'node_modules/.bin/vitest');\\n// CLI reporter options replace the config's reporter list. Preserve the existing\\n// ledger recorder alongside the installed-product evidence collector.\\nexport const RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORTER_ARGS = [\\n  '--reporter=default',\\n  `--reporter=${ADMIN_TEST_RUNS_REPORTER_PATH}`,\\n  `--reporter=${REPORTER}`,\\n];\\nconst OPERATOR_CORE = path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'packages/operator-core');\\n\\nexport interface LoggedChildResult {\\n  status: number | null;\\n  signal: NodeJS.Signals | null;\\n  error: Error | null;\\n}\\n\\n/**\\n * Run a child with stdout and stderr sent directly to a live log file. The file\\n * is created before spawn and the child inherits its descriptor, so long test\\n * legs remain observable while they run instead of only after exit.\\n */\\nexport function runChildWithLiveLog(\\n  command: string,\\n  args: string[],\\n  options: SpawnOptions,\\n  logPath: string,\\n): Promise<LoggedChildResult> {\\n  writeFileSync(logPath, `--- live child output started ${new Date().toISOString()} ---\\\\n`);\\n  const logFd = openSync(logPath, 'a');\\n  let child: ReturnType<typeof spawn>;\\n  try {\\n    child = spawn(command, args, { ...options, stdio: ['ignore', logFd, logFd] });\\n  } catch (caught) {\\n    closeSync(logFd);\\n    const error = caught instanceof Error ? caught : new Error(String(caught));\\n    appendFileSync(logPath, `\\\\n--- child spawn error: ${error.message} ---\\\\n`);\\n    return Promise.resolve({ status: null, signal: null, error });\\n  }\\n  closeSync(logFd);\\n\\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\\n    let processError: Error | null = null;\\n    child.once('error', (error) => { processError = error; });\\n    child.once('close', (status, signal) => {\\n      try {\\n        appendFileSync(logPath,\\n          `\\\\n--- child exit: code=${status ?? 'null'} signal=${signal ?? 'none'}${processError ? ` error=${processError.message}` : ''} ---\\\\n`);\\n        resolve({ status, signal, error: processError });\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        reject(error);\\n      }\\n    });\\n  });\\n}\\n\\nexport interface RealLeg {\\n  /** PUI_REAL_BACKEND: claude | codex | omp. */\\n  backend: string;\\n  /** Pinned per D-012; omitted only where D-013 refuses a pin (OMP under account=auto). */\\n  model?: string;\\n  env?: Record<string, string>;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface RunOptions {\\n  archive: string;\\n  advertise: Array<{ platform: string; backend: string }>;\\n  real?: RealLeg[];\\n  /** Vitest -t pattern; the full release run leaves it unset. */\\n  testFilter?: string;\\n  suites?: string[];\\n  out?: string;\\n  work?: string;\\n  /** Test seam: the platform this run's evidence is recorded against. */\\n  platform?: string;\\n}\\n\\nexport interface RunResult {\\n  verdict: Verdict;\\n  out: string;\\n  legs: Array<{ engine: string; status: number | null; evidence: string; rows: number }>;\\n  stockMachines: StockMachineResult[];\\n  cloudDeviceStart: CloudDeviceStartResult;\\n  suiteProvenance: Array<{ file: string; candidateBlob: string | null; runBlob: string | null }>;\\n  runnerTree: { before: RunnerTree; after: RunnerTree };\\n}\\n\\nexport interface StockMachineResult {\\n  image: string;\\n  /**\\n   * True when the host could not start a container at all (the create/start\\n   * preflight refused), so the image never ran the candidate. That says\\n   * nothing about the binary: it must not stop the PTY legs, which need no\\n   * Docker, and the smoke is measured again after them (WI-10004247 run 7).\\n   */\\n\"}]"},{"type":"input_text","text":"[\"runner_backend\",{\"chunk_id\":\"c6f75b\",\"wall_time_seconds\":0.000035118,\"exit_code\":0,\"original_token_count\":1058,\"output\":\"    env: {\\n      HOME: home, PATH: process.env.PATH, LANG: 'C.UTF-8', TERM: 'dumb', TMPDIR: path.join(home, 'tmp'),\\n      // install.sh finishes with `pui doctor`; keep it off the developer's live operator.\\n      PAPERCUSP_HONO_PORT: String(await closedPort()),\\n    },\\n  });\\n  if (install.status !== 0) {\\n    throw new Error(`install.sh failed (status ${install.status}):\\\\n${install.stdout}\\\\n${install.stderr}`.slice(-8_000));\\n  }\\n  const installRoot = realpathSync(path.join(home, '.local', 'share', 'pui'));\\n  const installed = realpathSync(path.join(installRoot, 'current', 'bin', 'pui'));\\n  const installedBinarySha256 = sha256(installed);\\n  if (listedDigest(unit, 'bin/pui') !== installedBinarySha256) {\\n    throw new Error(`installed ${installed} does not match the archive's CONTENTS.sha256 entry for bin/pui`);\\n  }\\n\\n  const platform = options.platform ?? detectPlatform();\\n  const legs: RunResult['legs'] = [];\\n  const rows: EvidenceRow[] = [];\\n  const suites = options.suites ?? RELEASE_SUITES;\\n  // When the stage itself runs under vitest (its R-12 test), the outer worker's\\n  // VITEST_* markers must not leak into the suites' own run.\\n  const inherited = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(process.env).filter(([key]) => !key.startsWith('VITEST')));\\n  // A binary that cannot start on stock Linux, or a cloud that measurably refuses\\n  // device starts, cannot earn a passing verdict. Keep writing the verdict, but\\n  // avoid launching expensive live legs. [] : [null, ...(options.real ?? [])];\\n  const acceptancePg = legsToRun.length ? await startAcceptancePg(work) : { env: {}, stop: async () => {} };\\n  try {\\n  for (const leg of legsToRun) {\\n    const engine = leg ? leg.backend : 'scripted';\\n    const evidence = path.join(work, `evidence-${engine}.json`);\\n    const run = await runChildWithLiveLog(VITEST, [\\n      'run', '--config', 'vitest.integration.config.ts',\\n      ...suites.map((file) => path.join(REPO_ROOT, file)),\\n      ...(options.testFilter ? ['-t', options.testFilter] : []),\\n      ...RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE_REPORTER_ARGS,\\n    ], {\\n      cwd: OPERATOR_CORE, timeout: 90 * 60_000,\\n      env: {\\n        ...inherited,\\n        ...acceptancePg.env,\\n        PUI_BIN: installed,\\n        // The store install.sh wrote. Suites run PUI under their own HOME, so a\\n        // journey that reads the release store must be pointed at this one.\\n        PUI_RELEASE_STORE: installRoot,\\n        PUI_RELEASE_PLATFORM: platform ?? '',\\n        PUI_RELEASE_EVIDENCE: evidence,\\n        ...(leg ? { PUI_REAL_ENGINE: '1', PUI_REAL_BACKEND: leg.backend, ...(leg.model ? { PUI_REAL_MODEL: leg.model } : {}), ...leg.env }\\n          : { PUI_REAL_ENGINE: '' }),\\n      },\\n    }, path.join(work, `vitest-${engine}.log`));\\n    const harvested = existsSync(evidence) ? (JSON.parse(readFileSync(evidence, 'utf8')) as EvidenceFile).rows : [];\\n    rows.push(...harvested);\\n    legs.push({ engine, status: run.status, evidence, rows: harvested.length });\\n  }\\n  } finally {\\n    await acceptancePg.stop();\\n  }\\n\\n  const candidate: Candidate = {\\n    sourceSha, artifact: provenance.target, archive, archiveSha256, installRoot, installedBinarySha256,\\n    advertise: options.advertise,\\n  };\\n  const contract = committed(sourceSha, 'apps/tui/PUBLIC_RELEASE_UX.md');\\n  const matrixText = committed(sourceSha, 'apps/tui/release/acceptance-matrix.json');\\n  const extra: string[] = [];\\n  cloudDeviceStartHistory = await remeasureCloudDeviceStart(cloudDeviceStartHistory);\\n  const cloudDeviceStart = cloudDeviceStartHistory[cloudDeviceStartHistory.length - 1];\\n  if (!cloudDeviceStart.ok) extra.push(`public cloud device-start smoke failed: ${cloudDeviceStart.problem}`);\\n  if (!contract) extra.push(`candidate ${sourceSha} carries no apps/tui/PUBLIC_RELEASE_UX.md`);\\n  if (!matrixText) extra.push(`candidate ${sourceSha} carries no apps/tui/release/acceptance-matrix.json`);\\n  if (!platform) extra.push(`this host (${process.platform}/${process.arch}) is not a platform in the release matrix`);\\n\"}]"},{"type":"input_text","text":"[\"runner_shell\",{\"chunk_id\":\"880785\",\"wall_time_seconds\":0.0000259,\"exit_code\":0,\"original_token_count\":1235,\"output\":\"#!/usr/bin/env bash\\n# The installed-TUI release stage (pui-first-party-public-release P-012 / D-018).\\n#\\n# Installs one candidate archive from apps/tui/scripts/package-release.sh into a\\n# clean HOME, drives the production-operator PTY suites through that installed\\n# bin/pui, and writes <archive>.acceptance.json. An archive may be published\\n# (P-014/P-015) only with a passing acceptance file for the same digest.\\n#\\n# Isolation (EI-24692155752067316). The stage runs tsx, vitest, the suites and\\n# the operator fixture from the checkout it executes in. Run from the shared\\n# working tree, a peer's half-written edit lands in the run: rehearsal\\n# 37bc2d4c32 lost its claude leg to a transient scripts/next-migration.js and\\n# its omp leg to a mid-edit syntax error in gateway.ts, neither of them PUI code.\\n# So this script checks out the archive's own source commit (PROVENANCE.json\\n# source.commit) with the release checkout helper, object-sourced and with\\n# node_modules captured under the maintained install-reader lock into an\\n# independent immutable generation, and runs\\n# the stage from there. Up to three reusable\\n# checkouts live under PUI_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKOUT_ROOT (default\\n# ~/.cache/pui-acceptance-checkouts) and are re-pinned on each use.\\n# PUI_ACCEPTANCE_ALLOW_LIVE_TREE=1 runs in place instead, for development only:\\n# the verdict then refuses (release-acceptance-run.ts runnerTreeRefusals).\\n#\\n# Exit 0 = accepted, 1 = refused (the file names every reason), 2 = could not run.\\n# --help prints the options. Setup output goes to stderr; stdout carries only\\n# the stage's own PUI_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE line.\\nset -euo pipefail\\n\\nROOT=\\\"$(cd \\\"$(dirname \\\"$0\\\")/../../..\\\" && pwd)\\\"\\nrun_in() {\\n  local root=\\\"$1\\\"; shift\\n  exec \\\"$root/node_modules/.bin/tsx\\\" \\\"$root/packages/operator-core/lib/pui-e2e/release-acceptance-cli.mts\\\" \\\"$@\\\"\\n}\\nfail() { echo \\\"release-acceptance: ERROR: $*\\\" >&2; exit 2; }\\n\\narchive=\\\"\\\"\\nargs=(\\\"$@\\\")\\nfor ((i = 0; i < ${#args[@]}; i++)); do\\n  case \\\"${args[i]}\\\" in\\n    --archive) archive=\\\"${args[i + 1]:-}\\\" ;;\\n    --archive=*) archive=\\\"${args[i]#--archive=}\\\" ;;\\n    -h|--help) run_in \\\"$ROOT\\\" \\\"$@\\\" ;;\\n  esac\\ndone\\n# No archive: the CLI prints its usage. Already re-executed, or opted out: run here.\\nif [ -z \\\"$archive\\\" ] || [ -n \\\"${PUI_ACCEPTANCE_ISOLATED:-}\\\" ] || [ \\\"${PUI_ACCEPTANCE_ALLOW_LIVE_TREE:-}\\\" = 1 ]; then\\n  run_in \\\"$ROOT\\\" \\\"$@\\\"\\nfi\\n\\n[ -f \\\"$archive\\\" ] || fail \\\"no archive at $archive\\\"\\nprovenance=\\\"$(tar -xzOf \\\"$archive\\\" --wildcards --no-wildcards-match-slash '*/PROVENANCE.json')\\\" \\\\\\n  || fail \\\"$archive carries no top-level PROVENANCE.json\\\"\\nsha=\\\"$(printf '%s' \\\"$provenance\\\" | node -e '\\n  let text = \\\"\\\";\\n  process.stdin.on(\\\"data\\\", (chunk) => { text += chunk; }).on(\\\"end\\\", () => {\\n    const commit = JSON.parse(text).source?.commit ?? \\\"\\\";\\n    if (!/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(commit)) process.exit(1);\\n    process.stdout.write(commit);\\n  });')\\\" || fail \\\"$archive PROVENANCE.json has no 40-hex source.commit\\\"\\n\\ncheckouts=\\\"${PUI_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKOUT_ROOT:-$HOME/.cache/pui-acceptance-checkouts}\\\"\\nmkdir -p \\\"$checkouts\\\"\\ncheckouts=\\\"$(cd \\\"$checkouts\\\" && pwd -P)\\\"\\n# A few reusable slots, each re-pinned per run: bounded disk, and a re-pin moves\\n# only what changed. One run per slot, since a second would re-pin the tree\\n# under the first. The lock is held by this process and everything it execs; a\\n# leftover child of an earlier run holds it too (`fuser -v <slot>.lock`).\\ncheckout=\\\"\\\"\\nfor slot in 1 2 3; do\\n  exec 9>\\\"$checkouts/slot-$slot.lock\\\"\\n  if flock -n 9; then checkout=\\\"$checkouts/slot-$slot\\\"; break; fi\\n  exec 9>&-\\ndone\\n[ -n \\\"$checkout\\\" ] || fail \\\"all three acceptance checkouts under $checkouts are held by other runs\\\"\\n\\necho \\\"release-acceptance: checking out candidate source $sha at $checkout\\\" >&2\\n# Freeze the shared helper and its adjacent sidecars before its long checkout\\n# work. Bash reads scripts lazily; a peer edit during materialization must not\\n# change the program this invocation is executing.\\n# Keep immutable dependency generations in the acceptance cache. Each slot\\n# consumes a validated donor while the shared integration tree may change.\\n# Use the maintained install-reader boundary throughout capture/materialization.\\nnode \\\"$ROOT/scripts/npm-install-safe.mjs\\\" --repo-root \\\"$ROOT\\\" --exec-under-lock -- \\\\\\n  bash \\\"$ROOT/apps/operator/scripts/systemd/papercusp-script-snapshot.sh\\\" \\\\\\n  \\\"$ROOT/apps/operator/bin/release/setup-release-checkout.sh\\\" \\\\\\n  --ref \\\"$sha\\\" --integration \\\"$ROOT\\\" --release \\\"$checkout\\\" \\\\\\n  --node-modules force --node-modules-copy copy --node-modules-generation required \\\\\\n  --dependency-generation-root \\\"$checkouts/dependency-generations\\\" \\\\\\n  --source-integrity object-sourced >&2 \\\\\\n  || fail \\\"could not check out $sha at $checkout (setup-release-checkout.sh failed; output above)\\\"\\nlanded=\\\"$(git -C \\\"$checkout\\\" rev-parse HEAD)\\\"\\n[ \\\"$landed\\\" = \\\"$sha\\\" ] || fail \\\"checkout $checkout is at $landed, not the candidate source $sha\\\"\\n\\nexport PUI_ACCEPTANCE_ISOLATED=\\\"$checkout\\\"\\nrun_in \\\"$checkout\\\" \\\"$@\\\"\\n\"}]"}],"internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough":{"turn_id":"01a12354-7a05-7373-9437-3faf5871e1b1","create_time":1791594745.4257376}},"metadata":{"client_authored":false,"fallback_token_limit_override":12000}}

{"timestamp":"2026-10-10T01:13:08.001Z","ordinal":403,"type":"event_msg","payload":{"type":"item_completed","thread_id":"01a12354-76df-7230-8a3e-7b5bc95a62ef","turn_id":"01a12354-7a05-7373-9437-3faf5871e1b1","item":{"type":"CommandExecution","id":"exec-f1e35bc9-c0da-4dfb-96ea-8c230b907ca6","process_id":"37065","command":["/bin/bash","-lc","sed -n '1,260p' apps/tui/scripts/package-release.sh"],"cwd":"file:///home/marsh-office/papercupai-workspace/papercusp","parsed_cmd":[{"type":"read","cmd":"sed -n '1,260p' apps/tui/scripts/package-release.sh","name":"package-release.sh","path":"apps/tui/scripts/package-release.sh"}],"source":"unified_exec_startup","status":"completed","aggregated_output":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# Build one public PUI release archive from ONE committed source generation\n# (pui-first-party-public-release P-011 / D-016).\n#\n# The unit is the same one the desktop sidecar ships (bin/pui + pui-companion.wasm\n# + a release-relative pui-install.json, built with the sidecar's stamps and\n# remap flags), plus the version-matched zellij, psu on a private pinned Node\n# (bin/psu → lib/node + lib/psu, D-031), the documents and a digest of every\n# file. Everything that goes into the archive — sources, templates and the\n# manifest/license tooling — is read from `git archive <sha>`, never from the\n# working tree, so an uncommitted edit cannot reach a release. psu is bundled\n# by bundle-psu.mjs, which serves every first-party byte from git at <sha> and\n# checks every npm package against that commit's package-lock.json.\n#\n# Reproducible by construction: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH is the commit time, the\n# source tree is exported to one constant absolute path, paths are remapped,\n# and the tar/gzip stream is normalised. Build it twice and compare.\nset -euo pipefail\n\nusage() {\n  cat <<'EOF'\nUsage: apps/tui/scripts/package-release.sh [options]\n\n  --target <t>     linux-x86_64 | macos-aarch64 | macos-x86_64 (default: this host)\n  --sha <rev>      committed source generation to build (default: HEAD)\n  --out <dir>      where the archive and SHA256SUMS go (default: dist/pui)\n  --sign-key <f>   minisign secret key; writes <archive>.minisig\n                   (or set PUI_RELEASE_MINISIGN_KEY)\n  --keep-work      keep the temporary build tree and print its path\n\nEnvironment:\n  PUI_PACKAGE_TARGET_DIR   cargo target dir for release builds\n                           (default: <cargo's configured target dir>/pui-package)\n  PUI_LINUX_GLIBC          glibc floor for linux targets (default 2.31; needs zig)\n  PAPERCUSP_ZIG_DIR        zig for cross builds (default ~/.papercusp/zig)\n\nPrints one line `PUI_PACKAGE_RESULT {json}` describing the archive.\nEOF\n}\n\ndie() {\n  echo \"package-release: ERROR: $*\" >&2\n  exit 1\n}\n\nTARGET=\"\"\nREV=\"HEAD\"\nOUT=\"\"\nSIGN_KEY=\"${PUI_RELEASE_MINISIGN_KEY:-}\"\nKEEP_WORK=0\nwhile (($#)); do\n  case \"$1\" in\n    --target) TARGET=\"${2:?--target needs a value}\"; shift 2 ;;\n    --target=*) TARGET=\"${1#*=}\"; shift ;;\n    --sha) REV=\"${2:?--sha needs a value}\"; shift 2 ;;\n    --sha=*) REV=\"${1#*=}\"; shift ;;\n    --out) OUT=\"${2:?--out needs a value}\"; shift 2 ;;\n    --out=*) OUT=\"${1#*=}\"; shift ;;\n    --sign-key) SIGN_KEY=\"${2:?--sign-key needs a value}\"; shift 2 ;;\n    --sign-key=*) SIGN_KEY=\"${1#*=}\"; shift ;;\n    --keep-work) KEEP_WORK=1; shift ;;\n    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;\n    *) usage >&2; die \"unknown argument: $1\" ;;\n  esac\ndone\n\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")\" && pwd)\"\nROOT=\"$(cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/../../..\" && pwd)\"\nOUT=\"${OUT:-$ROOT/dist/pui}\"\nfor tool in cargo git python3 node curl sha256sum tar gzip; do\n  command -v \"$tool\" >/dev/null || die \"missing required tool: $tool\"\ndone\n\ncase \"$(uname -s)\" in Linux) host_os=linux ;; Darwin) host_os=macos ;; *) host_os=unknown ;; esac\ncase \"$(uname -m)\" in x86_64|amd64) host_arch=x86_64 ;; arm64|aarch64) host_arch=aarch64 ;; *) host_arch=unknown ;; esac\nTARGET=\"${TARGET:-$host_os-$host_arch}\"\n\n# zellij 0.44.3 — the companion plugin API is version-coupled, so this is pinned\n# exactly. Digests are of the zellij BINARY and equal the upstream-published\n# zellij-<triple>.sha256sum (cross-checked 2026-09-23 for all three).\nZJ_VER=0.44.3\n# Node — the private runtime psu runs on (D-031), the same pin as the desktop\n# sidecar (build-desktop-sidecar.sh NODE_VERSION). Digests are of the upstream\\n# tarballs and equal nodejs.org's SHASUMS256.txt for this version (2026-09-26).\\nNODE_VER=v24.18.1\\ncase \\\"$TARGET\\\" in\\n  linux-x86_64)\\n    RUST_TRIPLE=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu\\n    ZJ_TRIPLE=x86_64-unknown-linux-musl\\n    ZJ_SHA256=397481870c4fc3bae646cd7613cde3a1cebdc204558a6cb9a7c603d4c852fc90\\n    NODE_PLATFORM=linux-x64\\n    NODE_SHA256=9f5eb6ac21845a66c493c91a253b1da32fd684e89e9b7202d4936982336be4ca\\n    ;;\\n  macos-aarch64)\\n    RUST_TRIPLE=aarch64-apple-darwin\\n    ZJ_TRIPLE=aarch64-apple-darwin\\n    ZJ_SHA256=99700a8c0afcf58f05651ccf543f9a84101dd2ea222c8e1cb06b57689425d693\\n    NODE_PLATFORM=darwin-arm64\\n    NODE_SHA256=eb02f7fab96d3d67de40c5ec8566096fcb4c2026728787683ae5a97eb612b941\\n    ;;\\n  macos-x86_64)\\n    RUST_TRIPLE=x86_64-apple-darwin\\n    ZJ_TRIPLE=x86_64-apple-darwin\\n    ZJ_SHA256=42dca16e7c852dd9c45485bb73457e090463b41ba8fade272b779ac33d54e642\\n    NODE_PLATFORM=darwin-x64\\n    NODE_SHA256=6fb20fceacbb157c2f95825b80df4a454a0f6d81cdcd7bb81eeae9147e0e76ec\\n    ;;\\n  *) die \\\"unsupported target $TARGET (linux-x86_64 | macos-aarch64 | macos-x86_64)\\\" ;;\\nesac\\nZJ_LICENSE_SHA256=9aa6c363b18a48eeecbffe13ff390c76ede2c90eb37ba17dfbbaffc42892d87d\\n\\n# ── the committed source generation ─────────────────────────────────────────\\nSHA=\\\"$(git -C \\\"$ROOT\\\" rev-parse --verify --quiet \\\"$REV^{commit}\\\")\\\" || die \\\"$REV is not a commit\\\"\\nEPOCH=\\\"$(git -C \\\"$ROOT\\\" show -s --format=%ct \\\"$SHA\\\")\\\"\\nVERSION=\\\"$(git -C \\\"$ROOT\\\" show \\\"$SHA:apps/tui/Cargo.toml\\\" | sed -n 's/^version = \\\"\\\\(.*\\\\)\\\"$/\\\\1/p' | head -1)\\\"\\n[[ -n \\\"$VERSION\\\" ]] || die \\\"could not read the pui version from $SHA:apps/tui/Cargo.toml\\\"\\nNAME=\\\"pui-$VERSION-$TARGET\\\"\\n\\n# The source tree is exported to ONE constant absolute path, whatever the\\n# target dir, user or machine. Cargo hashes the absolute path of a path\\n# dependency outside the building workspace (apps/pui-companion-proto, for both\\n# apps/tui and apps/pui-zellij-plugin) into -C metadata, which renames and\\n# reorders every symbol of the crates that depend on it: exporting under the\\n# target dir made two builds of one commit differ byte-for-byte. The same path\\n# also keeps RUSTFLAGS (which remaps it) constant, and RUSTFLAGS is part of\\n# every crate's cargo fingerprint, so warm builds stay warm. Because the path\\n# is shared, one packager runs per machine at a time (flock).\\nSRC=/tmp/pui-release-sr…486 tokens truncated… that store, then clear its Git environment when reading the submodule.\\n# Otherwise Git ignores -C and looks for LICENSE in the superproject store.\\n( unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE\\n  git -C \\\"$ROOT/libs/agent-chat\\\" cat-file -e \\\"$LICENSE_SHA:LICENSE\\\" \\\\\\n    || die \\\"agent-chat $LICENSE_SHA has no LICENSE file\\\"\\n  git -C \\\"$ROOT/libs/agent-chat\\\" show \\\"$LICENSE_SHA:LICENSE\\\" > \\\"$WORK/PUI_LICENSE\\\"\\n)\\n# compatibility.json is committed before the candidate it ships in exists, so it\\n# can never hold that candidate's installed-product evidence: a 'verified' target\\n# there is always evidence of another generation (R-10). Refused before anything\\n# is built; verified targets are advertised per candidate at the release stage.\\nVERIFIED=\\\"$(python3 -c 'import json, sys\\nprint(\\\" \\\".join(n for n, t in json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))[\\\"targets\\\"].items() if t.get(\\\"status\\\") == \\\"verified\\\"))' \\\\\\n  \\\"$SRC/apps/tui/release/compatibility.json\\\")\\\" || die \\\"could not read compatibility.json from $SHA\\\"\\n[[ -z \\\"$VERIFIED\\\" ]] || die \\\"compatibility.json in ${SHA:0:12} marks $VERIFIED verified, but installed evidence for this candidate cannot exist before it is built; record it at the release stage, not in the committed file\\\"\\necho \\\"→ packaging $NAME from ${SHA:0:12} (commit time $EPOCH)\\\"\\n\\n# ── build ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\\nexport SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=\\\"$EPOCH\\\"\\nexport PUI_BUILD_SHA=\\\"$SHA\\\" PUI_BUILD_DIRTY=0 PUI_BUILD_EPOCH=\\\"$EPOCH\\\"\\n# Later prefixes win in rustc: the source tree last, so it never reads as /build or /target.\\nREMAP=\\\"--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=/build --remap-path-prefix=$CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/target --remap-path-prefix=$SRC=/pui-src\\\"\\n\\nZIG_DIR=\\\"${PAPERCUSP_ZIG_DIR:-$HOME/.papercusp/zig}\\\"\\nZIG_VERSION=\\\"\\\"\\nif [[ -x \\\"$ZIG_DIR/zig\\\" ]]; then\\n  ZIG_VERSION=\\\"$(\\\"$ZIG_DIR/zig\\\" version)\\\"\\nfi\\n\\necho \\\"→ building the companion (wasm32-wasip1)…\\\"\\n( cd \\\"$SRC/apps/pui-zellij-plugin\\\" && RUSTFLAGS=\\\"$REMAP\\\" \\\\\\n    cargo build --release --locked --target wasm32-wasip1 )\\nWASM=\\\"$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/wasm32-wasip1/release/pui_companion.wasm\\\"\\n[[ -f \\\"$WASM\\\" ]] || die \\\"companion build did not produce $WASM\\\"\\nexport PUI_COMPANION_SHA256=\\\"$(sha256sum \\\"$WASM\\\" | cut -d' ' -f1)\\\"\\n\\nGLIBC_REQUEST=\\\"\\\"\\ncase \\\"$TARGET\\\" in\\n  linux-*)\\n    if [[ \\\"$host_os\\\" == linux && -n \\\"$ZIG_VERSION\\\" ]] && command -v cargo-zigbuild >/dev/null; then\\n      GLIBC_REQUEST=\\\"${PUI_LINUX_GLIBC:-2.31}\\\"\\n      echo \\\"→ building pui for $RUST_TRIPLE against glibc $GLIBC_REQUEST (cargo zigbuild)…\\\"\\n      ( cd \\\"$SRC/apps/tui\\\" && PATH=\\\"$ZIG_DIR:$PATH\\\" RUSTFLAGS=\\\"$REMAP\\\" \\\\\\n          cargo zigbuild --release --locked --target \\\"$RUST_TRIPLE.$GLIBC_REQUEST\\\" )\\n    else\\n      [[ \\\"$host_os-$host_arch\\\" == \\\"$TARGET\\\" ]] || die \\\"cross-building $TARGET needs zig at $ZIG_DIR and cargo-zigbuild\\\"\\n      echo \\\"→ building pui for $RUST_TRIPLE (host glibc;
